title: a deterministic gate that overrides a PASS audit narrative leaves no failure class, so the cycle gets no repair round
summary: Found root-causing cycle 1700 (2026-09-26). The auditor's narrative said PASS; EGPS forced FAIL with red_count=2 and named the two red predicates. decideAfterAuditFail then logged ORCHESTRATOR_AUDIT_REPAIR_DECLINED ('audit declared no failure class; nothing to base a retry on') and the cycle went straight to retro. The red predicate ids and their evidence files (runs/cycle-N/acs-red-evidence/) are exactly the information a repair round needs. Re-weighed 2026-09-28 (0.96 -> 0.6): the two cited cycles were pipeline faults, not build defects. Cycle 1700's reds came from the lane's EVOLVE_CYCLE_STATE_FILE leaking into predicate subprocesses (fixed by #647) and 1705's from guard:docdelete forcing an untracked archive the tree fence rejects (fixed by #651); both failure-decision.json records say infra-systemic, and a repair round would have run two futile retry@tdd rounds (1705's brief might even have staged the archive). In cycles 1686-1734 no static gate overrode a PASS narrative, so the narrowed fix is insurance, not a streak fix. Cycle 1735's acs-durable red (a gate-shaped test name) earned its repair because the auditor declared code-audit-fail itself.
fix: Design reviewed 2026-09-28 (architecture review, before code): declare the failure class per gate at its call site, not by fail() vs unavailable(). Stamp code-audit-fail only on the static gates whose offenders lie in the diff (gofmt, go vet, apicover-enforce and graduation, skills-drift, solution-contract, acs-durable); leave EGPS (red, unreadable, ship_eligible), host predicate execution and evidence, integration-tier and the explanation gates classless so retro decides, because one call site there covers composition faults, git I/O, toolchain errors and leaked environment. Carry it typed: cyclestate Diagnostic.Class (omitempty; never reuse Code, which cycleclassify reads as phase-refusal), CycleState.AuditGateClass set in persistFloorFailReasons and cleared in resetFloorFailReason (resume has no diagnostics), decideAfterAuditFail falls back to it after the auditor's block and emits class_source=auditor|gate. Components: (1) Diagnostic.Class, (2) AuditGateClass, (3) the decision fallback with table tests, (4) the static-gate stamping as the wiring commit, (5) ADR-0093 and the design doc.
acceptance: RED first: a narrative-PASS audit whose FAIL comes only from a static diff gate (gofmt, go vet, apicover, skills-drift, solution-contract, acs-durable) records AuditGateClass=code-audit-fail and earns the policy's repair round
An EGPS, host-predicate, integration-tier or explanation-gate FAIL over a PASS narrative stays classless and declines (retro decides)
The auditor's declared class takes precedence; a deterministic floor candidate still halts first; a spent repair cap still declines; the repair signal names class_source
Diagnostic.Class round-trips and is omitted when empty; resume reads AuditGateClass from the persisted state
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: Recurred in the window (1705) and turns every PASS-narrative gate FAIL into a terminal FAIL. A repair round would not have saved either instance (an env leak, a guard trap), so it sits just below 0.97.
